{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Intensity Momentum", "construction": "Calculate the change in research and development expenses over the past year, scaled by total assets, and then calculate the change in this ratio over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms that increase their R&D investments at an accelerating rate may be more likely to experience future growth and innovation, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Efficiency", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of advertising expenses to sales, and then calculate the change in this ratio over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms that decrease their advertising expenses as a percentage of sales over time may be more efficient in their marketing efforts, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Calculate the year-over-year growth rate of total employees, and then calculate the average of this growth rate over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with high and stable employee growth rates may be more likely to experience future expansion and success, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of capital expenditures over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with low volatility in capital expenditures may be more likely to experience stable and predictable cash flows, leading to lower returns, while firms with high volatility may be more likely to experience growth and innovation, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "Calculate the year-over-year change in inventory turnover, and then calculate the average of this change over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms that increase their inventory turnover at an accelerating rate may be more likely to experience future efficiency gains and cost savings, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Payable Days", "construction": "Calculate the average days it takes for the firm to pay its accounts payable, and then calculate the change in this metric over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms that decrease their accounts payable days over time may be more likely to experience future cash flow improvements and reduced financing costs, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Tangible Asset Intensity", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of tangible assets to total assets, and then calculate the average of this ratio over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with high tangible asset intensity may be more likely to experience future asset utilization efficiency gains, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "SG&A Expense Ratio Momentum", "construction": "Calculate the change in selling, general, and administrative expenses as a percentage of sales over the past year, and then calculate the change in this ratio over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms that decrease their SG&A expenses as a percentage of sales at an accelerating rate may be more likely to experience future cost savings and efficiency gains, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Depreciation Expense Ratio", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of depreciation expenses to total assets, and then calculate the average of this ratio over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with low depreciation expense ratios may be more likely to experience future asset utilization efficiency gains, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Fund Asset Return", "construction": "Calculate the return on pension fund assets over the past year, and then calculate the average of this return over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high returns on their pension fund assets may be more likely to experience future cash flow improvements and reduced pension liabilities, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
